lesson: A growth concept is not complete when the page feature is merged. It becomes reusable Powerhouse behavior only after the same product-led loop is projected into agent/chat inheritance, relevant skills, System Map, component registry, human docs, ledger and regression evidence.
prevention_rule: Future chats and agents must continue from this repository-backed loop and may not revert to contact-first or advice-only growth without measured evidence and same-lineage governance updates.
problem: The live Bedrijfslek growth mechanisms were not yet projected as one permanent inherited contract across agents, chats, relevant skills and the canonical System Map.
root_cause: Runtime implementation, basic learning and human documentation existed after PR #3301, but agent/chat inheritance and multi-skill/System Map discoverability were incomplete.
fix: Project the value-before-PII Bedrijfslek → Mini → teamchallenge → portal/order loop into AGENTS, Growth Swarm, SEO/CRO, Continuity, System Map, component registry, Brain learning, docs, ledger and regression evidence.
failed_approaches: Treating a merged page feature plus one learning file as sufficient permanent borging.
Allowing future chats to reconstruct the growth concept from conversational context instead of repository authority.
